scope: Commit-36 optional transformer forward paths, empty allocation and inherited cache detach diagnostic

missing_norm_input.source_rule: TransformerBlock.forward assigns y only inside each optional input-norm guard, but calls a present attention or MLP branch with y unconditionally.
effects: Attention without attn_norm reads y before assignment.
MLP without mlp_norm and without attention reads y before assignment.
MLP without mlp_norm after attention reuses the attention branch output instead of the updated residual x.
missing_norm_input.reach: The inspected Llama, Gemma2 and Phi3 builders all supply both input norms; external or dynamically constructed blocks remain possible but unverified.
missing_norm_input.execution_limit: No tensor forward path was executed.

empty_block_allocation.source_rule: allocate_transformer sums an empty numels list to zero, computes budget, then divides budget by numel before reaching its later Logic error assertion.
empty_block_allocation.effect: A direct allocation with neither attention nor MLP raises ZeroDivisionError rather than returning an empty strategy or explicitly rejecting the empty form.
empty_block_allocation.reach: The inspected conversion caller invokes allocate_q only when quantizable linears exist, so the empty case is not reached there.
empty_block_allocation.execution_limit: The repository allocation function was not executed for an empty block.

detach_count_persistence.source_rule: The commit does not touch cache.py; Cache.detach_from_model still formats its mismatched-count assertion with model_num_layers().
detach_count_persistence.reach: No direct in-tree caller was established at commit 35, and this commit adds none.
detach_count_persistence.execution_limit: No cache detachment workflow was executed.

limits: Source inspection and reviewer hand-checking only for the defect paths.
The draft's numeric allocation transcription does not execute repository quantization.
In-tree builders do not establish reach for missing norms or empty blocks.
